title: Business Analyst
description: Business Analyst – CSX Agentforce Transformation Role Summary The Business Analyst will serve as a key business and functional lead for Pearson's CSX Agentforce Transformation Program, driving the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of AI-powered customer service solutions across multiple business units. This role is responsible for translating business objectives into scalable Agentforce solutions, defining future-state customer service processes, leading discovery and requirements activities, and ensuring AI use cases deliver measurable business outcomes. The individual will work across business stakeholders, Salesforce teams, architects, Data Cloud specialists, and delivery partners to support the rollout of Agentforce capabilities across chat, email, voice, Agent Assist, and customer support operations. The role supports Pearson's broader customer service transformation strategy focused on service modernization, automation, operational efficiency, and improved customer experience. Key Responsibilities Own functional requirements, process design, and use-case definition across customer service operations. Partner with Customer Service, CSX, Product, Technology, and Salesforce teams to translate business strategies into scalable AI-powered solutions. Lead discovery workshops and current-state assessments to identify automation opportunities and AI use cases. Define future-state business processes, customer journeys, agent experiences, escalation paths, and service workflows enabled by Agentforce. Create and maintain business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, user journeys, and solution documentation. Own business design artifacts covering: Agent behavior Subagents (Topics) and actions Agent responses Escalation and handoff models Knowledge dependencies Data requirements Collaborate with Salesforce architects and technical teams to define: Service Cloud dependencies Data Cloud requirements Integration requirements Agentforce design patterns Drive backlog refinement, prioritization, and sprint planning activities to ensure alignment with business outcomes and roadmap commitments. Evaluate solution options, business impacts, risks, and implementation trade-offs. Define success metrics, KPIs, and measurement frameworks for Agentforce deployments, including customer experience, containment, automation, and efficiency outcomes. Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), release readiness, and hypercare activities to validate solutions meet business objectives. Establish and maintain Agentforce design standards, documentation standards, and governance processes. Act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders on Agentforce capabilities, AI opportunities, automation strategies, and service transformation initiatives. Required Experience & Skills 7+ years of Business Analysis, Product Ownership, Solution Analysis, or Business Architecture experience in enterprise environments. Experience delivering Salesforce Service Cloud solutions, customer service transformations, or contact center modernization programs. Strong understanding of customer service operating models, including: Case Management Knowledge Management Omni-Channel routing Contact center operations Workforce management Service KPIs Experience defining future-state business processes and operating models. Demonstrated ability to lead discovery, requirements gathering, and stakeholder workshops. Experience writing: Epics Features User Stories Acceptance Criteria Functional Specifications Experience supporting Agile delivery teams and Scrum ceremonies. Strong understanding of AI-driven business processes and automation opportunities. Ability to analyze complex business problems and translate them into scalable technology solutions. Experience working with cross-functional teams including business stakeholders, developers, architects, QA teams, and external vendors. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing senior leadership. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process improvement capabilities. Preferred Qualifications Salesforce Business Analyst Certification Salesforce Administrator Certification Salesforce AI Associate Certification Service Cloud Consultant Certification Experience with Salesforce Agentforce Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud Experience with conversational AI, virtual agents, chatbots, or customer service automation Experience within large-scale CRM, customer experience, or digital transformation programs Experience creating business cases, ROI models, and benefits realization frameworks Success Measures The successful candidate will be measured on: Delivery of Agentforce use cases into production. Achievement of automation and containment targets. Business adoption and stakeholder satisfaction. Improvement in CSAT and customer experience metrics. Reduction in agent effort and service costs. Quality of business requirements and solution designs. Successful execution of roadmap commitments. Continuous improvement of CSX delivery governance and business analysis practices. HCLTech is a global technology company, home to 230,000+ people across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services.

Our purpose is to bring together the best of technology and our people to supercharge progress. We’re supercharging progress for everyone, everywhere – our clients, partners and their stakeholders, our people, communities, and the planet.

Part of the HCL group, HCLTech was listed on the stock exchanges in India at the turn of the millennium in December 1999. Since our inception, we have pioneered several industry mainstays and established leadership positions in all our chosen segments.

As a company, we are deeply focused on accelerating our ESG agenda. We are also creating technology-enabled sustainable solutions with and for our clients and partners. We embed ESG imperatives into every aspect of our business and ensure that the progress we supercharge is responsible, inclusive and beneficial to all our stakeholders in the long term. We have committed to achieving net zero by 2040.

We recognize the impact that a business like ours can deliver in elevating communities globally, and we continue to improve our efforts and take decisive actions that benefit the communities in which we work and live. Through the HCL Foundation, the CSR arm of HCLTech, we have invested more than $130 million in social development efforts serving communities throughout India across education, health, water, sanitation and hygiene, skill development and livelihoods, environment, and disaster risk reduction, response and management.

We’re powered by our people – a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 167 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.

Consolidated revenues as of 12 months ending September 2026 totaled $14.8 billion. To learn how we can supercharge progress for you, visit hcltech.com.

Experience with JIRA, Confluence, Visio, or similar tools. Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodology. Understanding of API integrations and system interfaces. Strong documentation and process mapping skills. Experience: 5-10 Years of relevant experience as a Business Analyst with Banking Domain exposure

They will work closely with: Data Managers, who define the team's business requirements, objectives, strategy and priorities Data Engineers, who design and implement the processes by which data is collected and generated Data Quality Analysts, who define data quality control requirements and oversee these on a day to day basis to ensure constant system health Upstream data teams, who provide the data that the analyst is sourcing Downstream Process Owners, who depend on the data to perform their business function Data Analysts spend much of their time working with stakeholders to define data requirements, data transformation logic and supporting the delivery of these requirements from start to finish. They are experts in profiling data to understand its contents and will also have a working understanding of the business process or product that generated it in the first place.
